Overview

Maastricht is a city in Limburg with a population of 125,285. A historic, cosmopolitan city in the deep south with a distinct Burgundian flair, nestled between Belgium and Germany. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
